audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the chart contradicts the data. Disk reads Ryze / Skill / Renekton / Renekton / Ryze / Renekton / Renekton on both layers, while whys[0] calls level 1 'genuinely even', whys[1] describes Renekton punishing every forward step, whys[4] says 'he still controls the 1v1' at level 6, and whys[6] plus spikes[3] plus the late paragraph all say two items lands the matchup in Ryze's favour.
audit.why: 52.49% over 362 games: Renekton owns the lane, Ryze owns the game. The mirror has already flipped level 6 to Renekton in both of its layers, so this side must say the same.
audit.corrected: Skill / Renekton / Renekton / Renekton / Renekton / Renekton / Ryze, proposed as matched full+content pairs for the four rows that change, with ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] attributes the levels 4-5 attrition win to 'Renekton's Dominus-adjacent fury sustain'. Dominus is his level 6 ultimate and does not exist in that window; the actual sustain is Cull the Meek.
audit.why: Cull the Meek (Q) is 7s flat at 325 range, costs no mana, and heals him for part of the damage — more when he is above 50 Fury. That is the ability that wins a long trade at levels 4-5, and it is also the reason the missingInteractions file flags Grievous Wounds timing. Dominus (120/100/80s) is a bonus-Health stat steroid with no active combat effect beyond the aura.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 attrition is Cull the Meek's 7s heal, not Dominus; level 6 is Dominus refreshing his Fury while Realm Warp adds nothing to the duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Grievous Wounds requirement and the Ruthless Predator auto-attack reset never reach a field; dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d are filler, and dosFull[2].d invents a fifteen-second cooldown for a 16/14/12/10/8s ability.
audit.why: Kit: Ruthless Predator carries autoReset — his commit is telegraphed by the attack wind-up, not the cast — and above 50 Fury it becomes a three-slash 1.5s stun instead of 0.75s. Slice and Dice is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at 450 range. Mirror-confirmed on Ryze's side: Rune Prison is 615 range, 11s at rank 1, and roots only through Spell Flux; Overload is a first-target line missile that a minion will eat.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds before any extended trade; the Ruthless Predator wind-up is the step-back cue; his empowered stun is 1.5s, double the base.

edits.before: Realm Warp opens flanks and escapes, and your EQ DPS now duels most tops on their cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Dominus is an 80-120s stat steroid that keeps his Fury topped up — Realm Warp adds no duel power.

edits.before: Pre-item mana costs hamper your Flux cycling, and Renekton's Dominus-adjacent fury sustain means he wins extended trades in this window — Ryze plays defensive and farms.
edits.after: Pre-item mana costs hamper your Flux cycling, and Cull the Meek heals him back every 7s, so he wins extended trades in this window — Ryze plays defensive and farms.

edits.before: Renekton burns Ruthless Predator (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Cull the Meek heals him every 7s — get Grievous Wounds before trading long with him.

edits.before: That is Renekton’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator is an auto reset — the wind-up is your cue, not the cast.

notes: The missingInteractions entry 'Renekton's Ruthless Predator (W) absorbs your burst window' is a derived-flag misfire: Riot's text says the empowered W DESTROYS damage shields on the target, it does not grant Renekton one. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about him shielding. It is also moot here — Ryze has no shield in his kit. Both packet suspectNames are false positives; the names are spelled correctly.
